statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 210235 ≤ n → Even n → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≤ 210233 ∧ 2 ≤ n-p ∧ Nat.Coprime (n-p) 9699690

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8004 · 在完整模 9699690 的轮筛上构造 23 粗余项
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8004 · Construct a 23-rough remainder on the full 9699690 wheel

brief.zh: 先用 n%30030 选基类，再从三候选删去模 17 或 19 命中的至多两项。整数门槛保证差至少为二。
brief.en: Use n%30030 for the base class. Among its three candidates remove at most two forbidden by 17 and 19. The integer cutoff leaves a difference of at least two.
